author: Inside Edition
description: A man who survived a tornado that blew his house away while he was inside is speaking out about his miraculous survival. Trevor Kreke says he was recording a video about the approaching tornado in Effingham, Illinois when disaster struck. As Kreke took in the destruction, he could not believe he was okay. The single dad who works in marketing says he is grateful that his young daughter was away at her mom's house when the tornado ravished his home.
title: Man Who Survived Getting Swept Up By Tornado Speaks Out

author: Inside Edition
description: A man recorded a phone call from a scammer. The scammer identified themselves as a captain at a sheriff's department. The scammer told his target that he had missed jury duty and that he was in big trouble with the law. The call said it could make it all go away for $2,400. The call went on for 20 minutes. What the scammer did not know was that he was on the phone with an actual police captain from Ohio. When Captain Jacob Morris identified himself, the scammer knew the jig was up.
title: Scammer Calls Man Who Happened To Be Police Captain Asking For $2,400

author: Inside Edition
description: There was heartstopping drama in the sky as an airline pilot suffered a life-threatening medical emergency. It happened on an Air Canada flight. Passengers say that half an hour into the flight, the plane lurched violently. The pilot came out of the cockpit, apparently suffering from a seizure. Several passengers could be heard praying as others tried to restrain him. Rodney McDonald and was on board with his wife Sarah and their two young sons. They spoke with Inside Edition.
title: Pilot Suffers Medical Emergency During Flight

author: Inside Edition
description: Surveillance cameras captured the moment earthquakes shook the ground in Venezuela, sending people running for safety. For many, it was, sadly, too quick and too powerful to escape. More than 160 deaths have been reported so far, as rescuers dig through the rubble to search for bodies and survivors. More than a thousand people are reportedly injured and many more are assumed to be trapped under collapsed buildings. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: More than 160 Dead After 2 Earthquakes Strike Venezuela

author: Inside Edition
description: Officials in New York released videos of a deadly police involved shooting on Mother's Day. The Attorney General's Office says it released redacted bodyworn camera video from three Southampton Police Officers. The Police Department says they were responding to a call from a woman who said her son was threatening her. When they arrived, the officers say they found the suspect standing over a woman holding a knife. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Bodycam Video Shows Police Fatally Shoot Knife-Wielding Man On Mother's Day
